title: Downrite Engineering
description: downrite.com zoominfo.com/c/downrite-engineering-corp/354082568 Downrite Engineering 1983-founded, family-owned Florida specialty contractor (Flaxman family, now led by 2nd-generation Brandon Flaxman, ~200 employees, ~$40–50M revenue est., HQ Coconut Creek) covering the full "site infrastructure" stack: underground utilities (water/sewer/storm), unlimited-license electrical, traffic signals/ITS, fiber optics — and its signature niche, sports lighting, where it's the default design-build contractor for municipal athletic complexes, schools and parks across South Florida. Moats: vertical integration (one contract, one PM for fields + parking + signals + fiber), a 100+ vehicle fleet (40+ digger derricks, 20+ bucket trucks), hurricane-restoration demand, FDOT prequalification and 40-year municipal relationships; new ~9–10k sq ft HQ opened 2023. Bottom line: a quiet Florida infrastructure dynasty — digging, wiring and lighting the state since 1983, profiting every storm season.
